record.question: A Government servant marries a person who is not an Indian national. Under Rule 21 of CCS (Conduct) Rules, the Government servant is required to:
options: obtain prior permission from the Government before continuing in service
submit an application for post-facto approval within one year of marriage
forthwith intimate the fact of such marriage to the Government
report the marriage only while applying for or renewing a passport
